package.title: Avatars and stories on the own backend via /files and object storage

specification.intent: Move avatars and stories from client-side mocks to the own backend. Avatars (user profile and chat) upload through a new POST /files/avatars endpoint into RustFS with metadata in PostgreSQL and flow back as avatar_url fields in auth/chats/members responses (avatar pool stays as fallback). Stories become a real backend contract: POST /stories (multipart image), GET /stories feed (own first, then others, newest first; 24h TTL; per-viewer viewed flag), POST /stories/{id}/view. The chat page consumes the feed through a stories module inside the chats feature (src/features/chats/stories/: port, own adapter, controller, Store slice) instead of page-local mocks; the existing viewer/timer/page-ownership semantics stay unchanged.

requirements.title: User and chat avatars stored via /files + RustFS
requirements.description: Migration 007 (batch_alter_table): files.chat_id nullable, users/chats.avatar_file_id; POST /files/avatars (kind=user|chat, owner-only chats, image/* whitelist, size limit) stores the object and points the avatar column at it; avatar_url ("{file_id}/download" or null, a model property picked up by from_attributes responses) joins the auth user responses, GET /chats, GET /chats/{id} and members (members query widened in the chat repository/service); download of chat_id-NULL media opens to any authenticated user, chat attachments stay participant-only; the upgrade/downgrade round-trip is a manual evidence note against compose PostgreSQL.

requirements.title: Stories: upload, feed with viewed state, 24h TTL
requirements.description: stories + story_views tables; POST /stories (multipart image, same validation), GET /stories (active within story_ttl_hours, cap 100, own first then others, newest first, per-viewer viewed, owner display name and avatar), POST /stories/{id}/view idempotent 204; router registered next to files.

requirements.title: Frontend stories: backend-backed feed, upload, viewed ring
requirements.description: Stories module INSIDE the chats feature (src/features/chats/stories/, the chats/history precedent — cross-feature imports hit the guard): port, own adapter, module Store slice (state.stories), controller; the chat page drops initialStories/blob URLs, renders the Store feed with the static add tile first, fetches on CDM; on close it only resets the viewer and calls markViewed (numeric id) — the ring fades through the controller's synchronous slice patch before its POST; the picked file goes to uploadStory + refetch; viewer/timer/focus semantics untouched.

requirements.title: Frontend avatars: real avatars with pool fallback, uploads from profile and chat header
requirements.description: auth/chats/member mappings use avatar_url with avatarPoolUrl fallback; changeChatAvatar keeps its port signature and reads the clicked tile's chat id from the UI FormData chatId field (inputFile.ts), rebuilding it into the /files/avatars contract and refetching chats on success; profile changeAvatar narrows to Promise<{avatar: string}> and the controller patches state.user.avatar; the companion-avatar rule is preserved.

specification.goal: A reviewed backend+frontend plan replacing avatar-pool stubs and mock stories with the /files media pipeline.
constraints: Layers downward only; guard-architecture --all --strict stays green; no runtime api/ imports from UI; no cross-feature imports — the stories module lives inside the chats feature (chats/history precedent).
Block lifecycle truth of plan 2026-10-21-stories is preserved: the page owns the timer, overlay focus and delegated change; the viewer stays presentational.
Avatar URL convention: API returns "{file_id}/download" (no leading slash); leading-"/" values stay app static assets (avatar pool); story feed URLs are resolved to absolute URLs by the adapter.
Single source of truth for stories is the Store slice: the page never writes stories props; markViewed patches the slice synchronously before its POST.
No access widening beyond chat_id-NULL media for authenticated users; chat attachments stay participant-only (regression-pinned); cookies are SameSite=lax, same-site in dev.
Migration 007 additive and forward-only, batch_alter_table for altered column/FKs; the upgrade/downgrade round-trip against compose PostgreSQL is a manual evidence note, not an automated gate.
Mock stories (initialStories, ava-*.jpg tiles, URL.createObjectURL path) are removed; existing suites stay green.
nonGoals: WS push for new stories or avatar changes
story deletion, view counters, privacy lists
member avatars inside GET /chats (N+1 members debt stays separate)
specification.scope: backend/ (FastAPI services, models, schemas, endpoints, alembic, pytest) and frontend media consumption (chats stories module src/features/chats/stories/, auth/chats/profile adapters and controllers, chat page, Store slice, tests).

criteria.title: Avatar upload and avatar_url contract
criteria.statement: Migration 007 (batch_alter_table) reverses all five steps; a manual upgrade/downgrade round-trip against compose PostgreSQL is an evidence NOTE (not an automated gate); POST /files/avatars stores user/chat avatars (image/* whitelist, size limit, owner-only chats); avatar_url (model property) appears in auth responses, GET /chats, GET /chats/{id} and members; pytest covers the paths.

criteria.title: Download access: global media open, chat attachments closed
criteria.statement: GET /files/{id}/download keeps participant-only access for chat attachments (outsider 403 regression-pinned) while chat_id-NULL media downloads for any authenticated user.

criteria.title: Stories feed contract
criteria.statement: POST /stories validates and stores an image; GET /stories returns active stories (TTL, cap 100, own first then others, newest first) with per-viewer viewed; POST /stories/{id}/view is idempotent (204, single row) including for expired stories; 401 without auth.

criteria.title: Backend-backed stories on the chat page
criteria.statement: The stories module lives inside the chats feature; the page renders state.stories (mocks and blob URLs removed, add tile stays first), fetches on CDM, and on every close only resets the viewer while markViewed runs once with the numeric id — the ring fades through the controller's synchronous Store patch; the picked file goes through the controller; mocha pins the contract with stubs.

criteria.title: Real avatars with pool fallback and uploads
criteria.statement: Adapters map avatar_url with avatarPoolUrl fallback; changeChatAvatar keeps its port signature, reads the chat id from the UI FormData chatId field and refetches chats on success; profile changeAvatar (Promise<{avatar}>) patches state.user.avatar; the companion-avatar rule is preserved; mocha covers mappings and FormData rebuilds.

criteria.title: Gates and bookkeeping
criteria.statement: npm run verify:all and guard strict pass; the progress log gets an entry; no file outside the manifest write-sets changes.

releaseImpact: Backend media contract (avatars, stories) and its frontend consumption; Store gains a stories slice; no router, auth-flow or deployment changes.

securityGates.statement: Global media (chat_id NULL) is readable by authenticated users only; chat attachments stay participant-only (regression-pinned); avatar/story uploads enforce image/* and max_upload_bytes; chat avatar changes are owner-only.
No secrets or object keys leak into frontend contracts: avatar_url/image_url carry relative file paths only; no new env or deploy surface.
